facts.fact: 她不记得走回房子的路，只想象自己匆忙奔走、神经紧绷。
facts.anchor: I imagine I hurried, nervous energy coursing through my veins.

facts.fact: 深夜从正门进出最不易被发现，她因此绕到正门溜回房。
facts.anchor: The front door, this late at night, was the safest way in and out undetected.

facts.fact: 她的斗篷和裙子下摆湿透、右半身全湿，猜测途中在雪地里滑倒过。
facts.anchor: I must have slipped and fallen in the snow somewhere along the way.

facts.fact: 清晨她站在窗边，感到自己被困在一种阈限空间里、时间悬置。
facts.anchor: It felt, strangely, like I was caught in a liminal space, suspended in time.

facts.fact: 她来回踱步，等有人冲进来说领主沉在湖底。
facts.anchor: I paced instead, back and forth in front of the fire. I was waiting for something, for someone to barge in through the front door, screaming about the laird of the house being at the bottom of the loch.

facts.fact: 夜里她记起：车灯下那张脸是 Alexander 司机的脸，不是他本人。
facts.anchor: the face I had seen, in that quick moment, had been that of Alexander’s driver

facts.fact: 她想到自己是在害死丈夫之后睡在这张未整理的床上，这念头再也甩不掉。
facts.anchor: Once I had that thought, there was no getting rid of it

facts.fact: 结尾 Eliza 脸色苍白地抓住她的手，说「恐怕出了事故」。
facts.anchor: But Eliza stepped towards me and grabbed my hand, her grip so tight it was painful.
